name: National Farm to School Network
focus_area: Connecting schools to local farms and food producers through procurement, school gardens, and food and nutrition education
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could become a regional NFSN partner organization, supplying local produce and agricultural education programming directly to schools in their network.

name: Feeding America
focus_area: National hunger-relief network of 200+ food banks rescuing and distributing fresh produce to families facing food insecurity
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could donate or wholesale surplus produce to a local Feeding America member food bank, ensuring fresh microgreens and herbs reach food-insecure families.

name: FoodCorps
focus_area: National nonprofit placing food educators in schools to deliver nutrition education, school garden programming, and nourishing school meals
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could serve as a community farm service site for FoodCorps members, hosting youth in hands-on agricultural and nutrition education programming.

name: Wholesome Wave
focus_area: Increasing affordable access to fresh fruits and vegetables for low-income families through SNAP doubling and produce prescription programs
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could become a partner farm site where SNAP benefits are doubled through Wholesome Wave's Fresh For Less-style program, expanding access to farm produce.

name: KidsGardening
focus_area: National nonprofit supporting school and youth garden programs through grants, resources, and educator tools since 1982
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could partner with KidsGardening to co-apply for Youth Garden Grants and collaborate on curriculum resources for youth agricultural education programming.

name: The Food Project
focus_area: Youth development and sustainable agriculture nonprofit in eastern Massachusetts growing food on 70 acres and donating to local hunger-relief organizations
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could collaborate with The Food Project to cross-train youth, share best practices in teen farm employment, and co-distribute produce to underserved communities.

name: Urban Growers Collective
focus_area: Black- and women-led Chicago urban farm network running youth corps programs, mobile markets, and community herbalism apprenticeships to advance food equity
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could share programming models and partner on microgreens and herb growing training for youth and beginner BIPOC farmers.

name: Edible Schoolyard Project
focus_area: Nonprofit dedicated to transforming public education through organic school gardens and kitchen classrooms that teach nutrition, science, and community values
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could supply fresh microgreens and herbs to Edible Schoolyard partner schools and co-develop edible education curriculum grounded in farm-based learning.

name: Boys & Girls Clubs of America
focus_area: Youth-serving organization operating Healthy Habits programs emphasizing good nutrition, physical activity, and overall well-being for children and teens
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could host field trips and after-school garden programs at local Boys & Girls Club chapters, combining hands-on farming with nutrition education for youth.

name: YMCA of the USA
focus_area: Community wellness organization operating urban farms, gardens, mobile food markets, nutrition counseling, and healthy living programs for all ages
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could supply fresh produce and microgreens to YMCA mobile food markets and co-host community wellness events integrating gardening and nutrition education.

name: Farmers Market Coalition
focus_area: National nonprofit advocating for and supporting farmers markets, including SNAP/EBT acceptance, vendor education, and community food access
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could become a vendor at SNAP-accepting markets in FMC's network and use FMC resources to set up their own farm stand accepting federal nutrition benefits.

name: Cooperative Extension System / 4-H
focus_area: USDA-linked network of land-grant university educators delivering agriculture, nutrition, youth development, and community programs in every U.S. county
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could partner with their local county Extension office to co-host 4-H youth agriculture programming and leverage research-based farming and nutrition resources.

name: Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHC) Network
focus_area: Community health centers providing comprehensive primary care to underserved populations, increasingly integrating food-as-medicine and produce prescription programs
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could supply fresh produce and microgreens to a local FQHC's produce prescription or CSA box program for patients managing diet-related chronic conditions.

name: The Food Trust
focus_area: Philadelphia-based nonprofit delivering nutrition education and farm-to-school programming to 15,000+ students across Pennsylvania and New Jersey
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could partner with The Food Trust to supply locally grown microgreens and herbs to school cafeterias and co-deliver nutrition education in classrooms.

name: Wholesome Wave Georgia
focus_area: Georgia nonprofit matching SNAP/EBT dollars dollar-for-dollar at partner farmers markets and retailers for locally grown fruits and vegetables, plus produce prescriptions
partnership_angle: A Farm For All could enroll as a Fresh For Less partner farm site, allowing SNAP shoppers to double their benefits when purchasing the farm's microgreens, herbs, and produce.
